| White Rose Maths → CCSS Mapping v3 · regenerated from the Awsaj curriculum site (Aug 2026) |
| Codes verified lesson-by-lesson against the standard text; the site and this workbook are generated from the same data and always match. |
|  |
| Lesson counts: 913 distinct White Rose small steps on the map (PK4–Grade 5) plus 16 CCSS custom lessons still to be built (marked CCSS · BUILD on the site and orange in this workbook). |
| Coverage (K–Grade 5): 145 of 148 standards covered. Not covered anywhere: 2.NBT.B.6 (add up to four 2-digit numbers), 2.MD.A.3 (estimate lengths), 5.G.B.4 (classify 2-D figures in a hierarchy — a Grade 5 POWER standard). Each needs a CCSS custom lesson. |
| The 16 CCSS customs close the US-specific standards White Rose never reaches: bar-model word problems, length word problems and line plots (Gr.2), inch measurement and line plots plus equal-area partitioning (Gr.3), number patterns, fraction line plots and customary units (Gr.4), two-rule patterns, ordered pairs and fraction line plots (Gr.5). |
| Power standards: official Awsaj list (K 8 · G1 11 · G2 14 · G3 14 · G4 15 · G5 16 = 78). Lessons carrying one are highlighted on the site's pacing map. |
| PK4: no CCSS standards exist. Lessons are tagged with the Kindergarten standards they genuinely build toward; pure readiness lessons keep their K-Readiness category only. |
| A lesson may carry codes from more than one grade — White Rose teaches a year ahead, so many lessons serve their US grade and the one above. |
